apps.name: TutorPDF
apps.description: TutorPDF is a Flutter-based document utility application designed to help users access and work with documents on Android. Its document features include PDF, DOCX, and PPTX viewing, with optional AI-powered functionality for supported tasks.
features: Local PDF, DOCX, and PPTX document access and viewing
Optional Gemini-powered study assistance requires an API key configured in Settings

apps.name: Lingua School
apps.description: Lingua School is a Flutter student-management app for language schools, with searchable student records, profile details, and student data tools.
features: Search and sort student records, with inline edit and delete controls
View student profiles and manage records through a structured add-student form
Import and export CSV backups, with language, theme, and activity-log settings
